goal: Eliminate boilerplate and resource-management risks in wallet database queries
Make database query code safer and easier to maintain for future wallet work
agreement: Blocked by an unaddressed objection regarding copy safety
Unaddressed objection: copying the wrapper causes double finalization and crashes (polespinasa)
Unaddressed concern: trailing SQL is silently ignored without checking uncompiled code (Eunovo)
General approach supported across wallet reviews (vasild, pablomartin4btc, w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it is an internal database cleanup with no direct user-facing impact
Reduces resource-management risks and prepares the codebase for more complex queries
